title: Add Randomness page to documentation
description: Per Max's suggestion on PR #724: write a Randomness page explaining xgi's rng semantics (or pointing at numpy's rng docs). Should cover: int seed reuse → identical output, Generator reuse → state advances between calls, fresh Generator from same seed → identical output, int seed vs Generator built from same int → not equivalent. Reference the assertions in test_spring_layouts_rng_semantics as the canonical examples.
